tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

TLS certificate verification is enabled in all builds, development builds included, so there is no development-only exemption. The project also records that HTTPS is used everywhere with no exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. Its one paragraph says TLS certificate verification is on in all builds, development builds included, with no development-only exemption. It adds that the project records HTTPS everywhere with no exceptions.

Those two statements come from the two newest recorded decisions on this topic. I left out the retired option of disabling verification in dev builds.

Muninn also showed an earlier episode noting plain http for internal hosts. It isn't in the catalog as a decision, and the later "https everywhere, no exceptions" decision contradicts it, so I didn't include it.

The first attempt to create the file with a shell command failed with a parse error. I wrote it with the Write tool instead and did not read it back.
